apps.summary:
Halloween Jigcard Puzzle – Spooky Jigsaw Card Fun!
Get ready for a spooky puzzle adventure!
Halloween Jigcard Puzzle combines the relaxing satisfaction of jigsaw puzzles with a fresh card-moving experience. Slide, match, connect, and snap puzzle cards together to reveal charming Halloween pictures filled with pumpkins, ghosts, witches, black cats, haunted houses, and more.
Every puzzle starts with scattered picture cards. Look carefully, find the matching connections, and bring the image back to life piece by piece. When the right cards snap together, enjoy that satisfying feeling of watching your Halloween picture take shape!
Whether you love jigsaw puzzles, card puzzles, or simply want a relaxing way to enjoy the Halloween season, Halloween Jigcard Puzzle offers an easy-to-learn and delightfully spooky experience.
🎃 HOW TO PLAY
- Slide the Cards
Move puzzle cards freely across the board with simple swipe controls.
- Find the Connections
Look closely at each image and discover which cards belong together.
- Match & Snap
Place matching cards next to each other and watch them snap perfectly into place.
- Build Bigger Pieces
Connected cards stay together, letting you move entire sections of the picture at once.
- Complete the Picture
Keep matching until every card comes together and the full Halloween image is revealed!
👻 GAME FEATURES
🎃 A Halloween Puzzle Adventure
Explore a collection of spooky and cozy Halloween pictures featuring glowing pumpkins, mysterious castles, friendly ghosts, witches, black cats, autumn nights, and much more.
🧩 Jigsaw Puzzle Meets Card Puzzle
Enjoy a fresh twist on classic jigsaw puzzles. Instead of traditional puzzle pieces, move and connect picture cards to complete each scene.
✨ Satisfying Snap Moments
There is nothing better than finding the perfect match. Watch cards lock together and enjoy satisfying chain reactions as multiple pieces connect.
👉 Simple Swipe Controls
Just swipe, move, and match. The intuitive controls make it easy to start playing anytime.
🧠 Relaxing Yet Engaging
Take your time, observe the pictures, and find the right connections. No complicated rules—just relaxing puzzle-solving fun with a little Halloween mystery.
🌙 Spooky, Cozy & Beautiful Artwork
Discover atmospheric Halloween scenes ranging from cute and colorful to mysterious and magical.
🏆 Puzzles for Everyone
Easy to learn and satisfying to master, whether you're a casual puzzle player or a jigsaw fan looking for something different.
🕯️ ENTER THE HALLOWEEN WORLD

A black cat watching from the window.
A mysterious haunted house beneath the moon.
What picture is hiding inside the cards?
Slide the pieces, discover the connections, and reveal them all.
Download Halloween Jigcard Puzzle and start your spooky puzzle journey today!

apps.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: GS
apps.summary:
"The anthem of humanity is the hymn of bravery!"

The officially-licensed mobile game for the hit anime series Jojo's Bizarre Adventure! A faithful recreation of the original world from this multigenerational RPG — JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Golden Spirit is finally here! Take on the "golden spirit" of the Joestar bloodline and set out on a bizarre adventure of your own today!

▶ 3D Modeling + Live2D: Relive Iconic Moments
This is more than just a game: It's an entirely immersive experience for anime addicts! High-precision 3D models and Live2D are utilized to recreate iconic moments from the anime, frame by frame. Not only is the soundtrack composed by Yugo Kanno — mastermind behind both "Stardust Crusaders" and "The JoJoLands" OSTs — the 360° free camera view and cinematography turn every fight into a scintillating visual feast!

▶ Assemble an Ensemble of Jojos & Fight Alongside Their Stands
From "Phantom Blood" to "Stone Ocean," all the colorful characters from 6 generations of Jojos are here! Master your Stands and abilities to carefully command your characters to victory! Trigger iconic scenes from the original series as you activate your Stand abilities for finishing moves. Team up with characters from different series to weave an all-new bizarre adventure with the characters you love!

▶ Strategize With Rush & Turn the Tide of Combat
Just standing there and fighting is out, grandpa! Optimize each character's different attack range to configure combat and seize your chance to counterattack with a Rush. This game is stacked with all kinds of strategic elements, which is the key to recreating the anime's sense of psychological warfare. Push the envelope and seize victory — let strategy be your ultimate weapon!

▶ 360° Free Camera View & Real-Time Weather System
Immerse yourself in dynamic real-time combat with freely switchable camera angles. Enjoy a 360° view that captures the intensity of each blow. The volatile real-time weather system influences character abilities and combat dynamics, introducing unexpected twists to every battle!

▶ Build Your Dream Team With Multi-Faceted Progression Systems
Cultivate your characters through Stand awakening, skill enhancement, gear forging, and character ascension. Dive deep into a diverse cultivation system that offers unparalleled strategic flexibility. Discover the perfect synergy and build a dream team capable of crushing any foe!

▶ Relive the Original with Diverse Challenge Modes, World Bosses, and PvP
Multiple different challenge modes await: stages that immerse you in the original anime story; World Boss battles featuring powerful enemies from the anime; and even a ranked PvP mode for psychological warfare against players around the globe — prove that you are the true champion of this bizarre adventure!

apps.title: Water Sort : Color Puzzle
apps.summary:
Water Sort is a relaxing water sort puzzle where you pour colored water between bottles until every tube holds a single color. One rule, endless puzzles, and no pressure at all.

Free to play. Works offline. No timers, ever.

🧪 HOW TO PLAY

Tap a bottle to lift it
Tap another bottle to pour the water across
Water only pours onto a matching color, or into an empty tube
Sort every color into its own bottle to clear the level

That's it. Anyone can pick it up in ten seconds — and the later levels will still make you stop and think.

🌊 WHY THIS WATER SORT PUZZLE

UNLIMITED LEVELS — a fresh color puzzle every time, so you never hit a wall
ALWAYS SOLVABLE — every level is checked by a solver before it reaches you. No dead ends, no impossible boards
FULLY OFFLINE — airplane mode, subway, waiting room. It just works
NO TIME LIMIT — think for five seconds or five minutes. The puzzle waits
ONE-HAND PLAY — designed for thumb tapping, one bottle at a time
GENTLE START — begins with three colors and grows from there

💧 LIQUID THAT ACTUALLY FEELS LIKE LIQUID

Water sloshes when you lift a bottle, arcs as it pours, and settles when it lands. Complete a tube and it seals with a cork and a chime that rises higher with every bottle you finish in a row.

That little detail is why "one more level" turns into twenty.

⭐ BOOSTERS WHEN YOU WANT THEM

UNDO — step back a move, as often as you need
SHUFFLE — rearrange the board for a fresh angle
ADD TUBE — drop in an extra empty bottle for breathing room

Boosters save you time. They never unlock a level. Every water sort puzzle here can be solved without spending a single one — that's a design rule, not a promise.

🧠 A REAL BRAIN TEASER LATER ON

Early levels are a warm-up. Push deeper and the color sort puzzles turn into genuine logic challenges: more colors, fewer spare tubes, less room for error. From level 10 some liquids stay hidden until you pour, so you plan with incomplete information.

Every tenth level eases off on purpose, so the difficulty climbs without ever grinding you down.

🔇 PLAYS YOUR WAY

Music, sound and vibration each toggle separately. Play with the sound up for the full water experience, or on mute in a quiet room. Progress saves automatically after every level.

🎯 GOOD FOR

Puzzle players who like to think a few moves ahead
Anyone who finds sorting and organizing satisfying
A one-minute break, or an hour-long session
Any age — no reading needed, no violence, no countdown clocks

Water sort, color sort, liquid sort, bottle sort — whatever you call it, if a clean sorting puzzle sounds good right now, this one is ready.

Download Water Sort : Color Puzzle free and start pouring.

apps.title: Super Hand
apps.summary:
Super Hand is a platformer game about a hand. Just a hand. No body, no plan, no business being this determined. It wants a donut, and honestly, that's enough of a reason.
It used to belong to a baker named Varnava, who really should have kept a closer eye on it. The hand had a mind of its own and a serious weakness for anything glazed. One night it reached for a donut it definitely should not have touched, there was a glass case, there was a very loud noise, and long story short, the hand now lives its own life. The baker took it surprisingly well.
Then a pigeon showed up and stole the good donut. Not just any pigeon. An evil one. It grabbed the one donut that mattered and scattered a thousand others across the world, presumably for fun, because that is exactly the kind of thing this pigeon does. The hand took this personally.
So now it crawls. Finger over finger, ledge to ledge, hurling itself across gaps no five fingers should survive. It grabs onto walls. It flops off cliffs. It lands wrong and gets right back up, because it has exactly one goal and absolutely no shame. At the end of every level there's a donut, and the hand snatches it, and struts off looking for the next one.
And it will not stop talking. This hand has no eyes, no mouth, no ears, and a great deal to say about all of it. It will narrate its own jumps. It will insult the pigeon. It will get emotional about a donut. You are along for the ride whether you like it or not.
Inside the game:
A cozy, hand-painted platformer that is a lot sillier than it looks. Crawl, climb and jump through dozens of levels. Grab a donut at the end of each one. Hunt down one deeply unpleasant pigeon. Enjoy the running commentary of a hand who thinks it's hilarious. Get pulled through a story that makes almost no sense and completely works.
Super Hand is out now. Somewhere out there is a donut, an evil pigeon, and a hand with a point to prove.

A cozy, hand-painted platformer that is a lot sillier than it looks. Crawl, climb and jump through dozens of levels. Grab a donut at the end of each one. Hunt down one deeply unpleasant pigeon. Enjoy the running commentary of a hand who thinks it's hilarious. Get pulled through a story that makes almost no sense and completely works.
Super Hand is out now. Somewhere out there is a donut, an evil pigeon, and a hand with a point to prove.

Loop Master™: Color Jam Sort is a relaxing puzzle with a fresh conveyor twist, blending colorful sorting, smart crate filling, and smooth loop-based logic into a calm but satisfying experience.

🎮 In Loop Master™: Color Jam Sort, you sort colorful cubes and cards into matching crates in a relaxing conveyor loop puzzle with no timers and no rush. Just pure color sort gameplay that clears your mind while you clear the board. If you love sorting games with unique conveyor mechanics and cozy puzzle vibes, this is your perfect match.

🌀 Sorting in Motion

This is more than a simple color sort. The loop keeps everything moving, so timing, order, and space management matter just as much as matching the right colors.

🏆 One Conveyor Loop, One Goal

In Loop Master™: Color Jam Sort, every move is about keeping the conveyor flowing, matching colors efficiently, and making smart use of limited space.

• Tap to send cubes onto the conveyor and set the loop in motion.
• As cubes travel around the belt, they wait for the right crate to open up.
• Gather four cubes of the same color in one crate to combine them into a complete piece.

Keep the Loop Clear

• Watch the conveyor capacity carefully, because only a limited number of cube groups can stay on the loop at once.
• If the conveyor fills up and no useful moves remain, the round comes to an end.
• Every open slot can change your next move, so keeping space available is part of the puzzle itself.
• In some levels, only the top color is visible at first, while the cubes below stay hidden until they are revealed one by one.
• This hidden-color twist makes every early move more important, because one choice can affect which colors appear next.

Plan your moves, control the flow, and enjoy the satisfaction of every perfect merge.

⚡ Tools to Keep the Loop Moving

When the conveyor gets crowded, the right tool can help you fix mistakes, reopen space, and keep your sorting plan alive.

• Undo – Take the card on the conveyor back to the box and undo your last move. It’s perfect for correcting a rushed decision before it causes bigger problems.

• Shuffle – Select a plank and shuffle the color cubes inside. Use it to reset a tricky arrangement and open up new matching possibilities.

• Extra – Add 2 more capacity slots when you need more room. It gives you valuable breathing space when the loop gets tight and every open spot matters.

🎁 More Levels, More Rewards

Every completed level gives you something to look forward to. Win more levels to earn rewards, collect level gifts, and unlock limited-time perks like 30-minute unlimited lives that let you keep playing with fewer interruptions.

👍 Why You’ll Love It

• A fresh conveyor loop twist that makes every sort feel more dynamic.
• Clean, low-randomness puzzle play where smart planning pays off.
• Great for a quick break, with enough depth to keep longer sessions rewarding.
• Offline-friendly gameplay that fits wherever you want to play.
• A great match for fans of color sorting, card puzzles, and calm brain games.

Ready to clear the loop and master the flow? Start Loop Master™: Color Jam Sort now and enjoy a fresh sorting puzzle built around calm strategy and satisfying progress.

apps.title: AI Dungeon Master & RPG Fablia
apps.summary:
Fablia is an AI Dungeon Master that runs a fantasy RPG built around you. No group to schedule, no rulebook to memorise, no waiting for anyone else. Describe what your hero does, and the AI narrates what happens next.

A DUNGEON MASTER THAT NEVER RUNS OUT OF STORY
Type any action and the AI Dungeon Master answers it. Talk your way past the gate guards, torch the tavern, spare the bandit who begged, or walk away from the whole quest. The story bends around your choice and remembers what you did. No two runs tell the same tale, because nothing is scripted.

THREE WAYS TO BEGIN YOUR QUEST
• Quick Start — drop into an adventure in seconds
• Forge — a guided RPG character creator. Choose your age and origin, take the skills your past earned you, then spend your stat points
• Sandbox — no rules, no rails. Write your own world, set its laws, seed the people who matter, and tell the Dungeon Master exactly how to run it

ROLL THE DICE AND LIVE WITH IT
Skill checks are settled the tabletop way, with a real D20 roll rendered in 3D with sound and haptics. Beat the target and you stay on your feet. Miss it and fortune turns against you. Push your luck too far and you are rolling a death save.

YOUR HERO, YOUR RECORD
• Character sheet tracking stats, skills and gear
• Codex that fills in with the lore, people and places you uncover
• Chronicle of every scene in your campaign
• Multiple save slots, so several adventures can run side by side

BE ANYONE, WITH NO LIMITS
Play the knight who keeps their oath or the one who breaks it. Be a scheming merchant, a hedge witch, a deserter, a god-touched fool. The AI roleplay adapts to the character you actually write, not a class you picked from a list.

WHY PLAYERS PICK FABLIA
• A solo RPG you can play in five minutes or five hours
• Interactive fiction with real consequences, not a branching menu
• A text adventure where you type freely instead of tapping preset replies
• A choose your own adventure engine that never repeats itself
• Tabletop-style dungeon crawling without needing a party

WHAT YOU CAN DO
Explore ruined keeps and drowned shrines. Bargain, bluff and threaten your way through encounters. Recruit companions and lose them. Build a hero from nothing and watch the world start reacting to your name. Or throw all of it out and build a world of your own in Sandbox, down to how the Dungeon Master should narrate it.

Fablia is for anyone who loves fantasy RPG storytelling, interactive story games, AI roleplay, dungeon master simulators, text adventures and classic tabletop roleplaying, but wants it available the moment the mood strikes.

Your world is unwritten. Begin your quest.

apps.title: Narco Empire
apps.summary:
Pull yourself up from the gutter and take control of the underground in Narco Empire. Step into a raw, cinematic underbelly of secret labs, risky shipments, and bloody turf clashes — every choice about trust, risk, and ambition pushes you from a nobody on the block to a leader people fear.

From corner deals to the throne
Begin with small trades and tough calls. Make allies, collect favors, and turn tiny wins into real standing. As your influence grows, neighborhoods fall under your control, and each decision opens new chances — and new dangers.

Run the underground supply
Hunt down scarce materials across contested blocks and hide workshops that slowly turn into full operations. Close-up, hands-on lab scenes let you sharpen your product and raise its value on the black market. Improve how you work, bring in trusted hands, and scale from cramped benches to full factories.

Plot dangerous smuggling runs
Plan routes, prepare convoys, and react fast when things break down. Send guarded loads through hostile zones, pick stealth or force, bribe contacts, or sabotage rival narco crews — and always watch for checkpoints. Each successful run opens new trade corridors and extends your reach.

Turn goods into clout
Use distribution to build power: run street deals, land big wholesale contracts, and launder dirty cash into a respectable front. Oversee retail chains, pressure or partner with rivals, and plant investments that keep your empire hidden from view.

Keep the crown — and survive
Power draws betrayal. One mistake can wipe everything out. Recruit loyal lieutenants, sharpen your enforcers, and flush out moles before they strike. Diplomacy, threats, and targeted strikes are all in your playbook — but loyalties can flip overnight. Will you rule from the shadows, or become just another name in a police file?

Disclaimer: This game is a work of fiction. All substances, events, and characters portrayed are fictional. Please play responsibly.

Every puzzle is built around logic. Some connections are obvious at first glance. Others require a sharper eye and a little patience. Find the theme, group the right words, and watch the board clear with a satisfying pop.

If you enjoy word games, brain games, mind games, sorting puzzles, or calm logic challenges, Bubble Associations: Word Game is made for you.

• Match word bubbles to the correct categories
• Merge related words and clear the puzzle board
• Solve clever word association challenges
• Train your logic, vocabulary, and pattern recognition
• Enjoy relaxing gameplay with smooth, responsive controls
• Play thousands of handcrafted levels
• Discover simple puzzles, tricky puzzles, and smart category themes
• Use helpful boosters when a level gets difficult
• Play anytime with offline-friendly no wifi gameplay

Whether you want a quick word puzzle break or a longer brain training session, Bubble Associations: Word Game gives you a clean and relaxing way to challenge yourself.

apps.title: Spades Ace
apps.summary: Spades Ace is a timeless and widely loved trick-taking card game tailored for four players, who form two opposite sitting teams and compete cooperatively. Using a standard 52-card deck, the game follows a core fixed rule: spades serve as the permanent trump suit that beats all other suits in every round. Each round starts with blind bidding, where every player predicts their number of winning tricks, and the sum of teammates’ bids forms the compulsory team contract. During gameplay, participants play cards in clockwise order and must follow the lead suit if possible; players may play any card or trump with spades to seize the trick when they have no matching suit. Iconic mechanics such as high-reward Nil bids and cumulative bag penalties bring rich strategic layers, requiring players to flexibly switch between bold offense and steady defense. Teams gain points for successful contract completion and suffer point deductions for failed bids or excessive overtricks. Perfectly combining teamwork, logical judgment and tactical gameplay, Spades Ace is suitable for casual social entertainment and competitive matches, where the first team to hit 500 points wins the game.

apps.title: Lordrush
apps.summary:
Lordrush is a medieval tower defense strategy game where you rebuild a ruined fortress and defend your realm from attacks.

Gather resources, raise defenses, upgrade towers, and recruit heroes as you prepare for each assault.

Set in a harsh medieval world of stone castles, armored heroes, war-torn battlefields, and rival lords, Lordrush blends fortress building, resource management, hero strategy, and tactical defense.


• Fight for Resources
Wood, stone, and iron are essential for expansion. Compete with exiles, rebels, and other forces for control of vital resources.

• Build Fortress Walls
Construct defensive walls to slow enemy advances and give your towers more time to strike.

• Upgrade Towers
Place and upgrade towers to expand your firepower, increase damage, and hold key defensive positions.

• Strengthen Your Fortress
As enemy attacks grow stronger, reinforce your walls, expand your towers, and turn your settlement into a powerful medieval stronghold.

• Defend Against Sieges
Enemies attack your fortress in waves. Adjust your defenses based on enemy routes and strength, and hold the line.

• Recruit Heroes
Recruit medieval heroes with different abilities. Deploy them to change the course of battle.

• Make Tactical Choices
Every building, upgrade, and hero deployment can affect the outcome. Plan carefully to survive the next siege.

• Manage Your People
Assign survivors as workers, hunters, or cooks to maintain resource production, food supplies, and daily fortress operations.

• Maintain Health and Order
Your people’s condition affects productivity. Keep food stocked, maintain stability, and help your fortress continue to grow.

• Issue Decrees
Set rules under pressure from scarce resources and outside threats. Maintain order and guide the growth of your stronghold.

• Join Alliances
Create or join alliances, share resources, coordinate defenses, and face powerful enemies together.

• Challenge Other Lords
Train heroes, build squads, and compete for points, rare rewards, and greater influence across the continent.

• Claim the Throne
Start from a single fortress, build your defenses, gather resources, expand your power, and become a lord who cannot be ignored.

apps.summary:
Relax your mind with Zoodoku, a charming brain puzzle game where logic meets adorable animals. Place one animal in every colored territory while making sure no two animals share the same row or column—or touch diagonally.

Start with a friendly meow and solve delightful cat puzzles before discovering dogs, cows, and many more animal themes. Every level has one unique solution, so you can solve each challenge using pure logic instead of luck.

SIMPLE RULES, SATISFYING PUZZLES
Zoodoku is easy to learn but offers plenty of depth for fans of brain puzzles, Sudoku, and deduction games.
• One Animal per Territory
Place exactly one animal inside each colored region.
• One per Row and Column
Animals need their own space. No two animals can appear in the same row or column.
• No Touching
Animals cannot touch one another, even diagonally.
• Logic, Not Guessing
Observe the board, eliminate impossible spaces, and find the unique solution to every puzzle.

A FRESH ANIMAL LOGIC PUZZLE
Zoodoku combines Sudoku-style constraints with clever spatial deduction. There are no numbers and no math—only observation, reasoning, and the rewarding feeling of discovering the correct answer.
If you enjoy brain puzzle games, brain teaser games, or relaxing brain games, Zoodoku offers a fresh challenge that fits naturally into your day. Complete a quick puzzle during a break, solve a Daily Puzzle, or take on a longer series of levels at your own pace.

CATS, DOGS, COWS, AND MORE
Begin with a cute cat puzzle and unlock a growing collection of animal themes as you progress. Fans looking for a playful cat Sudoku alternative can enjoy the familiar satisfaction of Sudoku through a colorful, number-free logic system.
Each animal adds personality to the board while preserving the clear rules and thoughtful strategy at the heart of every puzzle.

FEATURES
• Hundreds of handcrafted brain puzzles
• A new Daily Puzzle to solve
• Cute cats and collectible animal themes
• Unique solutions with no guessing required
• Relaxing brain training for every skill level
• Clean visuals and intuitive controls
• Offline play anytime and anywhere
• No math or number skills required

RELAX AND TRAIN YOUR BRAIN
Zoodoku is designed for players who enjoy solving thoughtful challenges without pressure. Each level encourages concentration, pattern recognition, and logical deduction while keeping the experience calm and approachable.
Whether you search for brain games and puzzle challenges, brain puzzles, cat puzzle games, or a new way to exercise your mind, Zoodoku gives you satisfying logic gameplay in every level.
